Farmacias del Dr. Simi
offers continuous glucose monitoring systems like the CareSens Air, alongside traditional Bluetooth blood glucose meter kits.
They do not stock smartwatches, wearable ECGs, or remote patient monitoring hardware
, focusing instead on affordable localized diagnostic strips, monitors, and generic medications.
Dr. Simi
Available Health Monitoring Products at Dr. Simi
Continuous Glucose Monitors:
Systems like
CareSens Air
for continuous interstitial glucose tracking.
Blood Glucose Kits:
Traditional digital glucometers with Bluetooth connectivity (such as
CareSens S Fit
), lancets, and test strips.
Blood Pressure Devices:
Digital arm sphygmomanometers.
Dr. Simi
Wearable Technology Context
Smartwatches & Wearables:
Consumer smartwatches claiming non-invasive glucose tracking are not authorized or considered clinically accurate by regulatory bodies like the FDA. True continuous monitoring still requires an applied subcutaneous sensor filament rather than an optical wrist watch reading.
